evidence_quote: Signal Word: Danger. Hazard Statement: H226 Flammable liquid and vapour... Skin Irritation, Category 2 / Eye Irritation, Category 2 (Section 2, Devrinol 2-E SDS)

evidence_quote: Chronic Aquatic Toxicity Category 1 - (H410); signal word WARNING. Skin corrosion/irritation: Non-irritant (OECD404). No eye irritation (OECD405). Did not cause sensitization (OECD406)
